verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The local integral-PL decomposition, common projective residue model, ample domination, rational approximation, positive-current decomposition, integral scaling, residual nefness criterion, and limiting degree argument are valid. The cited GJR26, CLD12/CLD25, and Stacks Project results match their stated uses, and the boundary case follows by applying the boundaryless result to the interior.
